title: Companies (Management and Administration) Rules, 2014 — Rule 18, notice of meeting

content.note: Secondary reproduction of Rule 18, not Gazette-primary. The reproduced text addresses electronic notice, recipient email address, annual opportunity to register/update an email address, subject-line particulars, non-editable attachments/links, proof-of-sending records, transmission/failure allocation, and readability/retention of linked notice material. The official G.S.R. 560(E), 13 June 2018, notification confirms that the Explanation after rule 18(3)(ix) was omitted. This confirms that deletion only; the full consolidated current Rule 18 and all amendments remain to be reconciled against official primary sources.
